feature: Clear one warehouse bay into finite staging
scope: Physical non-timber whole-package bay clearance using existing Hauling actors, normal movement/pickup/deposit and existing fixtures/smoke. Remains in supplier PR146; no new animation or warehouse reload/refund work.

location.rationale: Outside construction bounds ending atY180, west of Supply TableX120 and north of supplier roadY200. One2.6x1m fixture plus1.1m service faces fits6x4m; authoritative routes and actual Area3D/worker occupancy still gate preparation.

acceptance: Warehouse inspection selects a real bay; explicit confirmation defaults Keep bay and revalidates session/bay/exact packages before mutation.

Atomically claim every whole supported unreserved package and reserve the entire matching staging cell layout. Source bay refuses new deposits/reconfiguration until the batch completes or stops safely.

A real Hauling worker visits staging before existing1.5s smoke/fixture preparation, then normal2s pickup, physical carry and2s deposit move exact package IDs, origins and counts; no instantaneous capacity gain.
Stage is source-only for ordinary jobs/output/overflow. Explicit recovery jobs alone can deposit their exact reserved cells. Staged goods remain physically usable by ordinary consumers.
One batch only; no next batch until actual staging is empty and active package/access promises clear. Occupied/preparing/blocked/in-use reasons are distinct.
Stop clearing releases uncollected claims; carried packages finish at staging before source lock releases. Staffing changes use existing safe carry handoff.
Reject timber even for light remainder until real paired transport/animation is connected; do not split or quietly single-carry it.

ownership.WarehouseRecovery: Warehouse-owned weak-reference coordinator for exact batch quote/claims/tagged normal haul jobs and source lock lifetime.
ownership.WarehouseService: Existing finite fixture/cell/access/Area3D and event-driven occupancy owner; staging bay excluded from ordinary receipt/module capacity.
ownership.RearSimulation: Existing shared actors, priorities, movement and timed preparation/pickup/deposit; tagged exact-package requests reuse these phases.
ownership.IdentityLedger: Atomic whole batch claims; scoped preserve-package carry option retains IDs without changing ordinary split semantics.
ownership.WarehouseView: Reuse actual existing fixture/smoke/package presentation in a staging root; no new art.

planned_cases: Existing foreign source claims/incoming promises/access refuse whole command unchanged.
A staging package picked up while another batch portion arrives cannot free the batch early.
No source lock release on pickup alone; wait for all safe deposits or stop completion.
Existing haul cancellation/reassignment must preserve shared batch claims and actual carried deposit.
Warehouse paths include staging fixture; ordinary receipt/source lookup must not assume every bay belongs to a warehouse module.
No per-frame stock scan or new global owner. Quote reads on UI command/refresh; staging emptiness follows indexed stock-change events.
verification: One brief GitHub-only current-change episode: clear one real partially occupied starter bay through actual shared workers and fixture prep, verify same IDs/origins and quantities at staging, source reopening and ordinary staged-stock collection. Changed-script parsing only otherwise. No local engine, regression suite, broad scenario or FPS claim.
